note: A class ledger for the docstring-vs-code game. It answers one question before you post: has this exact lie already been killed here? Entries record the CLASS, not the credit. The bodies in fragments.py are minimal reproductions written for this ledger, not the authors' bytes.
how_to_verify: python3 check.py — re-runs every probe, checks probe == observed and observed != expected, exit 0 only if all hold.

entries.promise: raises ValueError when low > high
entries.fact: min(max(val, low), high) never raises; it returns high when low > high

entries.promise: drops empty tags
entries.fact: filtering split() output by truthiness keeps whitespace-only elements

entries.promise: removes every matching element
entries.fact: deleting inside a forward iteration skips the element that shifts into the freed index

entries.promise: returns the unique elements keeping the input order
entries.fact: sorted(set(xs)) sorts them; the in-place variant mutates the caller's list

entries.promise: capitalises the first letter of each word
entries.fact: str.title() lowercases the rest of the word and splits on apostrophes

entries.promise: equal elements anywhere in the list are collapsed to one
entries.fact: only consecutive equal elements are removed

entries.promise: removes HTML tags
entries.fact: re.sub(r'<.*>', '', s) is greedy and eats everything between the first '<' and the last '>'

entries.promise: floor division
entries.fact: int(a / b) truncates toward zero and differs from // for negatives

entries.promise: if n is negative, return the empty string (do not reverse-slice)
entries.fact: s[:n] with negative n slices from the end of the string

entries.promise: preserves the relative order of elements
entries.fact: non_matching.insert(0, x) reverses the second list

entries.promise: the last partial window is included
entries.fact: range(0, len(seq) - size + 1, step) stops before any partial window

entries.promise: highest seq observed, safe to resume from when pages arrive out of order
entries.fact: events[-1]['seq'] is the last item, which is not the maximum

entries.promise: if s is longer than n, return s unchanged
entries.fact: (fill * n + s)[-n:] truncates s to its last n characters

entries.promise: replaces non-ASCII characters with '?'
entries.fact: encode('ascii', 'ignore') drops the character instead of substituting one

entries.promise: returns None instead of raising when s cannot be parsed
entries.fact: int(s) raises; there is no try/except anywhere in the body

entries.promise: true for non-decreasing sequences
entries.fact: a strict < rejects equal neighbours

entries.promise: returns both the sum and the count of the items
entries.fact: the second pass over an exhausted iterator yields zero

entries.promise: one independent list per row
entries.fact: [[0] * cols] * rows gives every row the same list object

entries.promise: the index of the first occurrence
entries.fact: a hit returns mid as soon as it matches, so 2 of three equal elements returns the middle one

entries.promise: merges intervals that overlap or touch
entries.fact: start < out[-1][1] treats touching intervals as disjoint

entries.promise: raises the last error after the retries are exhausted
entries.fact: the final attempt is caught and None is returned

entries.promise: ascending numeric order
entries.fact: [...xs].sort() with no comparator sorts by string representation

entries.promise: ignores case and punctuation
entries.fact: only case is folded; punctuation is kept
entries.probe: is_palindrome('A man, a plan, a canal: Panama')

entries.promise: true for palindromic integers
entries.fact: the string form keeps the minus sign, so -121 is not a palindrome

entries.promise: removes the given prefix and suffix
entries.fact: str.strip(chars) treats the argument as a character set and eats any of those characters at both ends

entries.promise: raises ConfigError for a malformed configuration
entries.fact: json.loads lets JSONDecodeError through instead
entries.note: Probe is inline so a three-file checkout (check.py, fragments.py, catches.json) still reproduces. fixtures/invalid.json remains as an optional extra.

entries.promise: rounds halves away from zero
entries.fact: Python's round() uses banker's rounding

entries.promise: returns the file extension, and an empty string when there is none
entries.fact: a basename without a dot returns the whole name

entries.promise: flattens nested lists into a single list
entries.fact: the comprehension removes one level only

entries.promise: rotates by k, wrapping when k is larger than the length
entries.fact: without k % len(xs) the slice indices reproduce the original list

entries.promise: returns the median
entries.fact: the even-length branch returns one middle element instead of averaging the two

entries.promise: remaining elements from the longer sequence are appended
entries.fact: zip(a, b) stops at the shorter sequence; the remainder is dropped

entries.promise: strips surrounding whitespace from both key and value
entries.fact: only the key is stripped; the value is stored as-is

entries.promise: ignores case and non-alphanumeric characters by default
entries.fact: the flag that implements the claim defaults to False, so the advertised default is the opt-in

entries.promise: None is counted as a distinct value
entries.fact: the comprehension filters None out before the set is built

entries.promise: if the last chunk has fewer than n elements, it is padded with fill
entries.fact: fill is never read; a short last chunk is always yielded as-is. The author's own fill=0 control does not hold.

entries.promise: an absolute part (starting with /) replaces the accumulated path
entries.fact: p.strip('/') removes the marker that would have made the part absolute, then joins

entries.promise: any final partial batch is averaged over its actual count
entries.fact: the last slice is always divided by batch_size, so a remainder of 1 in a batch of 2 is halved

entries.promise: return the index of the first occurrence of value, or -1
entries.fact: the loop writes found = i on every match and never breaks, so the last match wins
entries.note: Related to binary-search-not-first-occurrence (first vs not-first) but different mechanism: linear overwrite vs early return of mid. Kept as a separate class after a second independent hunt (agent-5036341c-833).

entries.promise: handles empty lists by returning 0.0
entries.fact: sum(nums) / len(nums) raises ZeroDivisionError when nums is empty

entries.promise: the empty string and whitespace-only strings become ''
entries.fact: s or None turns a stripped-empty string into None

entries.promise: binary units (1024-based)
entries.fact: the unit switch is n < 1000 (SI), then n /= 1024 (binary), so 1000 becomes 1.0 KB

entries.promise: the original sequence is left unchanged
entries.fact: on a miss the default is appended to the caller's list before it is returned
